- Vendor name: Please put the invoice to "Redwood Inference, Inc." — remit address and vendor ID will be provided by Finance below.

Hi Lara / team,

Thanks for sending the PO and W-9. A few notes from Finance after reviewing the PO: 

1) Legal entity: to ensure correct tax and remittance processing, please confirm the legal payee name exactly as registered for payments (we currently have "Aurum AI, Inc." on file). If that differs, please provide the exact name and EIN.
2) Remit-to: we can send invoices to AP@aurumai.com — we'll also CC billing@redwood.com for internal tracking.
3) Net terms: Redwood's baseline terms are Net30. For renewals where the customer requests extended terms, we require Finance approval. Given this is an upsell + renewal and long-term relationship, I'm prepared to approve Net45 for this cycle contingent on the PO being fully executed and the signed addendum returned. Net60 will need VP sign-off and credit review (which would delay invoice issuance).

Action items for Aurum: 
- Confirm legal payee name + EIN (or confirm it's "Aurum AI, Inc.").
- Confirm remit email is AP@aurumai.com and that PO number should appear in the invoice reference field.

I'll draft the invoice once we have those two confirmations and the signed addendum. Planning to issue on Friday if we have everything by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
